content: अक्षम {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Unfit, incompetent, unable; कार्यं˚, पलायन˚, उपवास˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Unable to bear or endure, not forbearing, non-forbearing; impatient; ˚मा कालहरणस्य <ls>Ś. 3</ls> unable to brook delay, admitting of no delay; मामक्षमं मण्डनकालहानेः <ls>R. 13. 16</ls>. .{@-मा@} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Impatience, intolerance; envy, jealousy; धावन्त्यमी मृगजवाक्षमयेव रथ्याः <ls>Ś. 1. 8</ls> as if envying (jealous of) the deerʼs speed. .²2 Anger, passion.
